Hephaistos_NextGen Tensor 1.1 及其他

我在哪里可以获得增强器？

如果需要，您可以在我的 Kofi 网站上免费获取增强器。如果您想支持我，请很高兴这样做......

基本上，它为面部、皮肤纹理、眼睛、手和更多其他东西增加了更多的真实感。我为此工作了几个月。现在我很高兴与大家分享:-)

This is a collection of workflows for my SDXL enhancer. Every workflow here is for a specific checkpoint. I am gonna add more workflows in the future here.

A detailed description is inside the Workflow...

Supported Models:

Hephaistos_NextGen_Lightning

https://civitai.com/models/331967/hephaistosnextgenlightning

A new very fast checkpoint and workflow. Its still experimental but worth a look.

FenrisXL Lightning by freek22

https://civitai.com/models/122793/fenrisxl

A tiny bit slower but worked extremly well with the enhancer. The checkpoint itself is more flexible than my experimental checkpoint above

Hephaistos_NextGen Tensor 1.1 & others

If you want the best results with my enhancer this is it..

This is a advanced WF with more options created for my Hephaistos NextGen Tensor 1.1 checkpoint. Well compared to the lightning models it is slow but worth it.

The checkpoint can be downloaded herehttps://tensor.art/models/697912008114231188

It should also work with Colossus XL V6https://civitai.com/models/147720/colossus-project-xl-sfwandnsfw

and many other models on civitai

I will add more checkpoints soon...

Where I can get the Enhancer?

You can get the Enhancer on my Kofi site for free if you want. In case you want to support me feel happy to do so...

https://ko-fi.com/s/34e553e28c

What does this Enhancer do?

Basically it adds more realism for faces, skin textures, eyes, hands and much more other stuff. I am working on this for months.. Now I am happy to share it with everyone :-)
